components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The clearest action on a scene, including desktop download.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0.78rem 1.35rem; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent-2, #3FD6CE); color: var(--color-ink, #0A0816); font: 700 1rem/1.65 "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, filter 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #9268FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-commitment path such as browsing compatible games.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 0.78rem 1.35rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #FFFFFF14); border-radius: 999px; background: #100D21; color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font: 700 1rem/1.65 "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.52); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #9268FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Catalogue Filter
components.description: A compact, explicit catalogue state selector.
components.css: .ds-filter { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.5); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.15); box-shadow: inset 0 -1px rgba(63, 214, 206, 0.28); color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font: 400 0.78rem/1.65 "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms ease, background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-filter span { color: rgba(245, 245, 247, 0.55); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-filter:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent, #9268FF); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #9268FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Catalogue search with a persistent, readable placeholder.
components.css: .ds-search { display: grid; gap: 0.55rem; color: var(--color-muted, #9AA3B5); font: 600 0.75rem/1.45 "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search-shell { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0.8rem; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; transform: translateY(-50%); fill: none; stroke: var(--color-muted, #9AA3B5); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.6rem 0.8rem 0.6rem 2.35rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #FFFFFF14); border-radius: 12px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font: 400 0.82rem/1.65 "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #9AA3B5); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #9268FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verified Badge
components.description: An evidence status that always names its meaning.
components.css: .ds-badge-verified { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3rem; padding: 0.24rem 0.48rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(74, 217, 145, 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px currentColor; color: var(--color-verified, #4AD991); font: 700 0.68rem/1 "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.name: Catalogue Card
components.description: An image-led game result with an explicit compatibility grade.
components.html: ✓ VerifiedPalworldView compatibility →
components.css: .ds-game-card { display: grid; width: min(13rem, 100%); gap: 0.55rem; color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font-family: "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-game-art { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09); border-radius: 12.8px; background: var(--color-surface, #16122A); box-shadow: 0 1rem 2.6rem -2rem rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.5); } .ds-game-art img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 520ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), filter 520ms ease; } .ds-game-status { position: absolute; top: 0.55rem; right: 0.55rem; display: inline-flex; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.24rem 0.48rem; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(74, 217, 145, 0.15); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px currentColor; color: var(--color-verified, #4AD991); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; } .ds-game-edge { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--color-accent, #9268FF), var(--color-accent-2, #3FD6CE)); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 160ms ease; } .ds-game-card strong { font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-game-card > span:last-child { color: var(--color-muted, #9AA3B5); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-game-card:hover img { filter: saturate(1.06); transform: scale(1.035); } .ds-game-card:hover .ds-game-edge { opacity: 1; } .ds-game-card:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #9268FF); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; min-height: 4rem; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 0.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #FFFFFF14); background: rgba(6, 4, 16, 0.9); color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font-family: "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 650; } .ds-brand span { display: grid; width: 1.65rem; height: 1.65rem; place-items: center; border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-ink, #0A0816); color: var(--color-accent, #9268FF); font-weight: 800; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-nav-links a { position: relative; padding: 0.55rem 0.75rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--color-muted, #9AA3B5); font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-nav-links a:hover, .ds-nav-links .ds-nav-active { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045); color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); } .ds-nav-active::after { position: absolute; right: 50%; bottom: 0.25rem; width: 3px; height: 3px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--color-accent-2, #3FD6CE); content: ""; } .ds-nav-download { display: inline-grid; min-height: 2.75rem; place-items: center; padding-inline: 1.1rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent-2, #3FD6CE); color: var(--color-ink, #0A0816) !important; font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 760; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #9268FF); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-portal { position: relative; isolation: isolate; display: grid; min-height: 18rem; grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.5fr 1fr; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; overflow: hidden; padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.28); border-radius: 16px; background: radial-gradient(circle at 18% 30%, rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.13), transparent 34%), radial-gradient(circle at 82% 70%, rgba(63, 214, 206, 0.09), transparent 36%), #090717; color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font-family: "Geologica Variable", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-portal-source, .ds-portal-result { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; gap: 0.65rem; color: var(--color-muted, #9AA3B5); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-portal-source strong { display: grid; min-height: 9rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16); border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #5C40B0, #228C86); color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-portal-threshold { position: absolute; top: -10%; bottom: -10%; left: 47%; width: 2px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, transparent, var(--color-accent, #9268FF), var(--color-accent-2, #3FD6CE), transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 20px 3px rgba(146, 104, 255, 0.24), 0 0 54px 14px rgba(63, 214, 206, 0.08); transform: rotate(7deg); } .ds-portal-result { grid-column: 3; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid rgba(63, 214, 206, 0.24); border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(10, 8, 22, 0.72); } .ds-portal-result em { color: var(--color-verified, #4AD991); font-style: normal; } .ds-portal-result strong { color: var(--color-fg, #F5F5F7); font-size: 1.15rem; } .ds-portal-result > span { width: fit-content; padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-accent-2, #3FD6CE); color: var(--color-ink, #0A0816); font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview:
Pixel Port is a cinematic passage from uncertain Windows-game compatibility to a clear, evidence-backed Mac launch. Its violet-black environment feels focused rather than gloomy: real game artwork, compatibility grades, and launch data remain the subject while amethyst and teal describe the route through the product.

The visual voice is cinematic, precise, and reassuring. Generous scenes create drama, compact controls keep decisions direct, and the portal motif gives technical transformation a physical form without exposing terminal-heavy complexity. Dark tonal layers, fine spectral lines, and limited ambient glows provide depth; the interface does not depend on decorative glass or constant neon.

Layouts are fluid and content-led. The core wrapper tops out at 80rem with `clamp(1.25rem, 3vw, 2.5rem)` gutters, display copy stays balanced and short, and body copy is capped near 65–75 characters. Motion uses a fast 160ms cut for control feedback and a 520–900ms cinematic cadence for meaningful transitions, with an instant reduced-motion path.
keyCharacteristics: Violet-black tonal depth with amethyst-to-teal portal energy
Real game artwork and evidence before decoration
Large, balanced Geologica display type with calm supporting copy
Device-aware conversion and responsive layouts from 20rem upward
Explicit status language that never relies on color alone

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Compatibility colors are reserved for compatibility meaning and always travel with a label, icon, or both.

rules.name: The Two-Energy Rule
rules.body: Deep Amethyst explains structure and passage; Signal Teal identifies the clearest next action. Do not make both colors compete for the same role.

rules.name: The One Family, Many Gears Rule
rules.body: Use Geologica’s variable weight and decisive scale changes before introducing another typeface.

rules.name: The Plain Technical Language Rule
rules.body: Technical credibility comes from precise words and observable evidence, not monospace costumes or strings of uppercase metadata.

rules.name: The Grounded-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are separated by tone and one-pixel lines first. A glow or shadow must explain portal energy, hierarchy, or interaction state.

dos: Do lead with real game artwork, catalogue counts, compatibility labels, and launch evidence.
Do keep body copy at `#9AA3B5` or brighter on the violet-black background and verify at least 4.5:1 contrast.
Do use `#3FD6CE` with `#0A0816` text for the clearest primary action.
Do pair every compatibility color with plain-language status text and an icon where space permits.
Do use 12px controls, 16px signature surfaces, and full pills only for compact actions or statuses.
Do use `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` for purposeful cinematic movement and provide an instant reduced-motion alternative.
Do adapt the conversion path to the visitor’s device rather than presenting a desktop-only action as the mobile default.
donts: Don't resemble a terminal-heavy compatibility tool; keep technical detail readable and human.
Don't become a generic neon gamer site; amethyst and teal are directional signals, not constant glow.
Don't become an overpromising utility that hides caveats; preserve grades, limitations, and evidence near decisions.
Don't use compatibility colors decoratively or rely on color alone to convey a grade.
Don't add gradient-filled text, decorative grid overlays, repeated uppercase eyebrows, or numbered section scaffolding.
Don't spread glass panels and broad shadows across generic cards; depth must have a structural purpose.
Don't exceed a 16px card radius without a named signature reason, and never use a pill radius on a content card.
Don't animate content from an invisible default or remove essential context on small screens.
